body.name: Exact simultaneous multinomial projection
body.construction: For a multinomial count vector \(u\) of total \(N\), let \(T_p(u)=2\{\ell_{\widehat p(u)}(u)-\ell_p(u)\}\), with \(0\log 0=0\), and define \(\operatorname{pv}_N(p;u)=\sum_{z:\sum_jz_j=N,\ T_p(z)\geq T_p(u)}\operatorname{Mult}_N(z;p)\) and \(\Gamma_N(u;\gamma)=\{p\in\Delta:\operatorname{pv}_N(p;u)\geq\gamma\}\). For each arm, use the multinomial categories \(\{\varnothing\}\cup(\mathcal T\times\mathcal V)\), with probabilities \(p^a_{tv}=b_{tav}\) and \(p^a_{\varnothing}=1-\sum_{t,v}b_{tav}\); for each period of the external sample, use categories \(\mathcal V_0\) with probabilities \(q_t\). Let \(\mathcal G_{n,m}(\alpha)\) contain every \(b',q'\) accepted by all four exact tests at level \(\alpha/4\), conditional on realized arm sizes. At fixed \(\delta\), define \(\mathcal C_{n,m,\delta}^{\mathrm{exact}}=\operatorname{cl}\bigcup_{(b',q')\in\mathcal G_{n,m}(\alpha):\mathcal P_\delta(b',q',\omega)\neq\varnothing}\Theta_{I,\delta}(b',q',\omega)\). This enumeration includes zero observed and zero candidate cells and uses no studentization or selected optimizer.
